quick_guide.text: Check that the tow vehicle's hitch ball is 2 inches and rated for at least 2,995 lb, and that the ball, hitch and coupler have no cracks, wear or looseness.

source_refs.locator: p. 6, 1.2.4 warning; pp. 36-37, "Coupling to the Tow Vehicle"

quick_guide.text: Grease the ball, open the coupler, raise it above the ball with the jack and back the tow vehicle under it.

Lower the coupler fully onto the ball, close the latch and put the pin or lock through it. Test it: use the trailer jack to raise the rear of the tow vehicle 1 inch (no more), then lower and wind the jack fully up.

source_refs.locator: p. 38, "Couple the trailer to the tow vehicle"

quick_guide.text: Cross the safety chains under the coupler and hook them to the tow vehicle's frame (not to the hitch unless it has loops for chains), with the S-hooks put in from underneath. Leave enough slack to turn, but not enough to drag.
Connect the 4-way plug and check the tail, brake and turn lights with a helper.
Look for tire damage, set the pressure printed on the trailer's VIN label (front left) while the tires are cold, and check that the lug nuts are tight.
Load with the trailer hitched and on level ground: about 60% of the load in the front half, heavy items on the floor over the axle, and no more than 2,995 lb for trailer and load together.
Strap the load to the tie-down loops, raise and latch the ramp gate, and put a linchpin in the latch if it has a hole for one.
Every 50 miles or hour of towing, stop and check the coupler, chains, load and latches.
To unhitch: block the tires, unplug, unhook the chains, open the coupler, make sure the ground under the jack will hold, then wind the jack down to lift the tongue.

source_refs.locator: p. 41, "Uncoupling the Ball Hitch Trailer with Tongue Jack"

warnings.text: Do not move the trailer until the coupler is locked, the chains are attached and the jack is fully raised.
Never carry people, or flammable, explosive or poisonous materials.
60 mph is the maximum recommended towing speed, and only in ideal conditions.
If the trailer sways, ease off the accelerator and steer as little as possible. Do not brake the tow vehicle to correct it.

support_notes.text: Lights out: check the 4-way connection first (an improper connection leaves the lights dead). Staff can compare the contacts with Big Tex's 4-way connector sheet.
Lug-nut torque questions: Big Tex's manual has no torque table (placeholder on p. 70). Refer the renter to Northridge staff; do not quote a number.

headline.text: 12 ft single-axle utility trailer with a 4 ft ramp gate. It tows on a 2-inch ball rated for 2,995 lb or more and has no brakes.
headline.status_reason: Facts from the OEM product page.

quick_start_text.text:
1. 2 in ball, 2,995 lb or more. Not cracked, worn or loose.
2. Seat, latch, pin. Lift-test ≤ 1 in, then jack fully up.
3. Cross the chains under the coupler, hooks up from below.
4. Plug in the 4-way. Check tail, brake and turn lights.
5. Tires undamaged, cold pressure per VIN label, lug nuts tight.
6. Load hitched, level: about 60% in front, heavy over axle.
7. Strap to the tie-down loops. Gate latched, pin if fitted.
8. Every 50 mi or hour: check coupler, chains, load, gate.
The Start-Up Guide shows each step.

safety_notes.text:
Don't move until the coupler is pinned, the chains are on and the jack is up.
No riders.
No flammable, explosive or poisonous loads.
60 mph maximum, in ideal conditions only.
If it sways: ease off the gas, steer as little as possible, don't brake.
Trailer and load together: 2,995 lb at most.

fuel_power_notes.status_reason: No fuel or power system; the lights run from the tow vehicle, covered in the quick start.

troubleshooting_notes.text:
Lights not working: check the 4-way plug is fully connected.
Coupler won't latch: check the ball is 2 inches. Don't tow until it locks.
Anything cracked, loose or damaged: don't tow. Use Request Support.

return_notes.text:
Return the straps, chain pins and spare tire.
Unhitch: block the tires, unplug, unhook the chains, open the coupler, jack down on firm ground.
Use Return checklist when you drop it off.
